performance.verdict: Meta dark 9 days; 5 overdue milestones mean scoreboard is untrustworthy.

findings.text: Meta channel_dark confirmed: $0 spend and 0 leads for 9 consecutive days (Sep 15–23); last active day was Sep 14 at $37.85.
OVERDUE (Jul 23): Renewal closed at $2,200 — prove-it month accountability and client walk-risk still unresolved after 63 days.
OVERDUE (Aug 7 / Aug 14 / Aug 31 x2): Phone-match attribution, sync cleanup, dashboard, and August scoreboard all missed; 56 GHL opps, 0 won, 0 appointments recorded.
3-day signal (Sep 21–23) vs prior 3 (Sep 18–20): spend $0 vs $0, leads $0 vs $0 — campaign has been fully flat for 9 days, not a blip.
GBP dropped -64% in 7d; IG reach -98%; organic signals collapsing in same window Meta went dark — brand visibility across all surfaces falling simultaneously.

suggestions.text: Immediately diagnose and reactivate Meta campaign; $0 spend for 9 days is a confirmed zero-output leak.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has delivered $0 spend and 0 leads for 9 consecutive days (Sep 15–23), despite the 28-day top campaign 'BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness' having spent $285.84 prior. Diagnose today: check campaign status, payment method, ad account flags, and policy holds — then reactivate or escalate. Success is confirmed when daily spend resumes above $13/day (the series low during active days) within 48 hours. Re-check 2026-09-27.

suggestions.text: Escalate 4 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer/Sohib; dashboard and scoreboard missing blocks renewal decision.
suggestions.monday_update: Four milestones are overdue by 23–62 days: phone-match attribution (Aug 7), sync/contact cleanup (Aug 14), dashboard live (Aug 31), and August scoreboard trusted (Aug 31). With 56 GHL opportunities created, 0 won, and 0 appointments recorded, the client's own scoreboard — leads → schedule → show → patient — cannot be read. Nacer and Sohib must confirm delivery status and set hard dates by 2026-09-26. Success is a Monday item with owner and completion date assigned for each.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP recovery after Meta reactivation; -64% GBP drop probable co-symptom, not independent cause.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell -64% and IG reach fell -98% in the same 7-day window Meta went dark, suggesting brand suppression across surfaces rather than a standalone organic problem. No independent action is warranted until Meta is back live and spend has normalized for 3 days. Re-check GBP actions trend on 2026-09-30; if GBP remains below 5 actions/day after Meta is active, escalate as a separate organic finding.
